context: A teacher and student discuss a WWII documentary
purpose: Teach: 戦犯/爆破/暴動/ナチス/部落/慰安/暴行/売春

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 昨夜の番組、戦犯裁判の記録、丁寧でしたね。
lines.en: Last night's program — the war crimes trial documentation was really thorough.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful opening. Gentle curiosity in the voice. Speaking to an engaged student, not lecturing. Warm professional tone, with slight pause before the dash.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。ナチス政権下の暴動と、組織的な暴行の記録、衝撃でした。
lines.en: Yes. The records of riots under Nazi rule and systematic violence — that was genuinely shocking.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. Respectful of the weight of the subject. Steady pace, not rushed. A student processing something serious out loud, trusting the teacher to hear him.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 被占領地の部落で行われた慰安所制度、歴史学では大きな論点です。
lines.en: The comfort station system in occupied territories — that's a major point of discussion in historical scholarship.
lines.style: Clear, academic register but not cold. Bringing knowledge into the conversation as an offering. Deliberate pacing. Treating Ren as capable of understanding the complexity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 戦時下の売春問題、研究で多角的にとらえられていますね。
lines.en: Wartime sex-work issues — they're being approached from multiple angles in the research now.
lines.style: Careful, exploratory tone. Building on what Asuka said without overspeaking. Slightly tentative, thinking alongside the teacher rather than at her. Respectful hesitation.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 施設の爆破による証拠隠滅も、当時報じられました。
lines.en: The destruction of those facilities to hide evidence — that was documented at the time as well.
lines.style: Quiet gravity. Slow, deliberate pace on each phrase. The closing of a difficult conversation treated with appropriate weight. No brightness, but steady composure.
